subject: health
essentialQuestion: How can understanding relationships, consent, and communication help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?

prompts.prompt: Explain respect and boundaries in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of consent as clear ongoing and reversible.
Apply assertive communication in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving conflict and repair; correct it and explain why.
Connect respect and boundaries with online relationships. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Practice communication and bystander scripts with opt-out from role-play and no personal disclosure.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.
